description:
What is This Part?
This is the Engine Rebuild “Complete Gasket & Oil Seal Kit”.
Comes with a “True Graphite” Cylinder Head Gasket and “Natural Cork” Valve Cover Gasket.
This kit also supplies you with the Oil Pump & Crank Shaft Oil Seals, the Valve Stem Oil Seals plus all required Gaskets.
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Exhaust Manifold Gasket
Qty 1 – Intake Manifold Gasket
Qty 1 – Valve Cover Gasket
Qty 1 – Cylinder Head Gasket
Qty 1 – Fuel Pump Gasket
Qty 3 – Carburetor Gaskets
Qty 1 – Water Pump Gasket
Qty 1 – Thermostat Housing Gasket
Qty 1 – Oil Pan Gasket
Qty 1 – Oil Pump Gasket
Qty 1 – Oil Seal Housing Gasket
Qty 1 – Front Crank Shaft Oil Seal
Qty 1 – Oil Pump Oil Seal
Qty 8 – Valve Stem Oil Seals
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
